sources.title: iimran/EmotionDetection · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository hosts a fine-tuned emotion detection model built on BERT-base-cased. The model is trained on the ma2za/many_emotions dataset to classify text into one of seven emotion categories: anger, fear, joy, love, sadness, surprise, and neutral. The model is available in both PyTorch and ONNX formats for efficient deployment.

sources.title: GitHub - sb-ai-lab/EmotiEffLib: Efficient face emotion recognition in ...
sources.snippet: EmotiEffLib (ex-HSEmotion) is a lightweight library for emotion and engagement recognition in photos and videos. It can be used in Python and C++. It provides flexibility with backend support for Pytorch and ONNX, enabling efficient real-time analysis across various platforms. This repository contains two implementations of EmotiEffLib: Python and C++.

sources.title: Pre-trained Models | sb-ai-lab/EmotiEffLib | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the pre-trained models available in EmotiEffLib for emotion and engagement recognition. The models are optimized for facial expression analysis and provide various trade-offs between accuracy, speed, and size.

sources.title: Models | sb-ai-lab/EmotiEffLib | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Emotion Recognition Models - For classifying facial expressions into emotional categories Engagement Classification Models - For detecting engagement levels from sequences of facial images These models are available in multiple formats to support different deployment scenarios, including PyTorch, ONNX, and TorchScript.
